1. (Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that differs from allocation to a second antenna__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __to a different antenna than the first broadcast channel__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and allocated to the first broadcast channel on a first antenna__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __specific to the first broadcast channel__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __and allocated to the second broadcast channel on a second antenna distinct from the first antenna__.

5. (Previously presented) The method as set forth in Claim 1, further comprising, for a second one of the symbols, allocating substantially all the subcarriers to the second broadcast channel.

6. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information __on a first antenna__, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and control information __on a second antenna__.

19. (Currently Amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that differs from allocation to a second antenna__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel __to a different antenna than the first broadcast channel__.

20. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and allocated to the first broadcast channel on a first antenna__.

21. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __specific to the first broadcast channel__.

22. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information __on a first antenna__, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and other control information __on a second antenna__.
